name: 49509 · Wyoming, MI
findings: ZIP 49509 (Wyoming) has 76 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49509 (Wyoming) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
